//: There was no build configuration at all. Every build was a manual local
one on one Mac, and the Android release keystore existed only on that
machine — lose it and the Play listing can never be updated again. EAS
holds the credentials, which is the actual fix for that.
EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL is set per profile and MUST be. lib/api throws at
startup in a non-dev build when it is missing, deliberately: the
alternative is an app that ships pointing at localhost and fails every
request on every device with no clue why.
Both profiles point at the Render test API (free plan). Move to a paid plan or custom domain before launch.
origin (e.g. https://fault-api.onrender.com) before the first store build.
They are deliberately unresolvable (RFC 2606). A release build that still
carries one shows a 'cannot reach its server' screen naming this variable
instead of failing every request as a connection problem — see lib/api.ts
and DEPLOY.md.
ADVERTS: the preview/development profiles carry GOOGLE'S PUBLIC TEST ad
units, and app.config.js falls back to Google's test APP ids. That is
correct for internal testing and NOT for release: serving test ads to
the public is an AdMob policy violation, and they earn nothing. Before
the store build, set the real unit ids on the production profile and
ADMOB_IOS_APP_ID / ADMOB_ANDROID_APP_ID as EAS secrets (DEPLOY.md 5).

ios.//: appleId, ascAppId and appleTeamId come from App Store Connect.

android.//: Path to a Play service-account key. Never commit the file itself.
